articles.title: A Stranger on a Plane Drew Her Brain — and Changed Everything
articles.summary: Rebecca Simonitsch was scared about brain surgery. On her flight home, the man next to her turned out to be a brain expert. He drew pictures to explain the surgery, and his kindness gave her hope. She's been seizure-free for 25 years.

articles.title: Why President Trump Hit Pause on a New Spy Boss
articles.summary: President Trump delayed the confirmation of his spy chief pick, Jay Clayton. He wants lawmakers to pass a surveillance law and a voter ID law first. The acting spy chief, Bill Pulte, will stay for now. Some senators are frustrated.

articles.title: Tropical Storm Arthur Kicks Off Hurricane Season with a Soaking
articles.summary: Tropical Storm Arthur is the first named storm of the Atlantic season. It's near Texas with 40 mph winds. The biggest danger is heavy rain — up to 20 inches in some spots — which could cause dangerous flash floods.
